scrape.metaDescription: Official website of the last family-owned Genevan luxury watch manufacturer. Enter the Patek Philippe universe to discover our watches and savoir-faire.
paragraphSample: Assembling one of the world's most extraordinary watch collections, our Museum showcases our legacy and represents an inexhaustible source of inspiration for our designers and artists.
